rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2BA grading and gives plausible ICM/TE descriptions, but it overinterprets image-specific details such as exact ICM position, lower-hemisphere cavity prominence, and zona features that may not be reliably visible.

Integrates age, male factor, BMI, prior failed cycles, endometrium, and embryo grade into prognosis well, though it overstates recurrent implantation failure concerns after only two prior unsuccessful cycles and infers issues not clearly supported by the data.

The response is structured and mostly logical, but there are inconsistencies: it labels the case as unexplained implantation failure/RIF too strongly, gives overlapping probability ranges where implantation is lower than clinical pregnancy, and makes some unsupported probability adjustments.

Core recommendations like eSET and attention to transfer technique/luteal support are guideline-consistent, but several suggestions (routine aspirin, ERA, thrombophilia/immunologic testing, NK cells, endometrial scratch, broad PGT-A use in a 26-year-old) are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, including specific tests and management options, though some are more speculative than evidence-based for this patient.
